chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: Duke arranges Perdido on the train for that night's dance
summary: Tizol gave Duke the melody on the train; Duke made a quick arrangement, he extracted it, and the band played it that night.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You were talking about Perdito -- you were singing it to Jeffrey on the train?

Well, I have it to Duke; that was when I wrote Perdito on the coach we were traveling in, and I gave it to Duke, the melody of Perdito, and he took it right there and made some kind of an arrangement -- a small thing -- on the trip where we were going to play a dance.

I extracted it, so we wrote it, he arranged it, and I extracted it and we played it that same night, because there was nothing to the first arrangement of Perdito, you know?

Da, da, da -- one of those things. So it really came out very fine.
